missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Хозяйство' is the neuter nominative as the subject of 'развивается'. 'Сельское' is the agreeing neuter adjective naming agriculture.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Хозяйство' is the neuter accusative direct object of 'ведёт', identical to the nominative. 'Большое' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Хозяйства' is the genitive form modifying 'состояния'. The chain 'от состояния хозяйства' shows what the outcome depends on.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В хозяйстве' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to show where the animals are. 'Нашем' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Хозяйству' is the dative form required by 'помогать', which governs the dative. 'Правительство' is the neuter nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after заниматься. 'Хозяйством' is the instrumental form required by 'заниматься'. 'Домашним' agrees in the neuter instrumental, meaning household chores.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after много. 'Хозяйств' is the genitive plural required by the quantifier 'много'. 'Крепких' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Хозяйства' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'приносят'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'доход' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Хозяйство' is the neuter accusative direct object of 'развиваем', identical to the nominative. 'Своё' marks possession.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Хозяйства' is the genitive form modifying 'состояние'. 'Мирового' agrees in the genitive, naming the world economy as the topic.
